scope: QA-only pre-change metadata; no account records or credentials

invite_policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM business_members m
  WHERE ((m.business_id = business_invites.business_id) AND (m.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (m.status = 'active'::text) AND (m.role = ANY (ARRAY['founder'::text, 'administrator'::text, 'manager'::text])))))
